svg.title: Prudently — Agent Fleet Architecture
svg.desc: A hospital operations agent fleet on Google Cloud, us-central1. A Coordinator on Vertex AI Agent Engine routes every call through an Agent Gateway to six specialists. Supply Chain reaches a Medical Representative agent across an external trust boundary over Agent2Agent, where Model Armor screens inbound vendor mail twice before any model sees it. A fleet watch runs continuously and wakes an agent the moment stock, fatigue, a credential, or a surgical schedule conflict crosses a line — no human input — and every consequential action is still gated behind manager approval in the loop. Firestore, Vertex AI Memory Bank, Cloud Trace and Logging, Secret Manager, Cloud KMS and IAM back every agent.
svg.text: Hospital operations agent fleet. Every box below is deployed and running on Google Cloud, us-central1.

svg.text: Real Google Cloud products: Agent Engine · Memory Bank · Model Armor · Cloud Run · Firestore · Cloud Trace · Cloud Logging · Secret Manager · Cloud KMS · IAM · Firebase Auth

Built on ADK primitives where no distinct product exists: Agent Registry (Firestore catalog) · Agent Gateway (before_tool_callback) — Agent Identity is real per-agent IAM, each engine its own dedicated service account
